task: Bangkok editorial research batch 3 — full bundles, tier A (research only; no live app data changed)
popularity_method: No citywide popularity measure has been collected. Coverage breadth is measured for batch selection only (windowed, publisher-family-deduped scan); it is a research-selection signal, never a popularity score.

selection.method: tier A of the A2 tiering: station areas ranked 5-9 plus the ARL control (#12); districts ranked 5-8
deferred: din-daeng (#9) and khlong-san (#10) districts to tier B

entities.name_en: Ha Yaek Lat Phrao / Phahon Yothin
entities.name_th: ห้าแยกลาดพร้าว / พหลโยธิน
aliases: Phahon Yothin (MRT, merged into one area)
entities.scope_notes: Merged interchange area: BTS Ha Yaek Lat Phrao + MRT Phahon Yothin count as ONE scored area (<=450 m merge rule). Northern mid-ring at the Phahonyothin/Lat Phrao junction; district Chatuchak per app data. Chatuchak and Rot Fai parks sit north — check buffer vs polygon (green 10, 38.1 ha mapped). Clipped by neighboring rated areas; coordinator polygon checks apply.
entities.selection_rationale: Rank #5/133; the only top-10 merged BTS+MRT area outside the core; green 10 (38.1 ha) needs the buffer-vs-polygon check; rent is a Chatuchak district blend.

entities.scope_notes: BTS Phloen Chit (Sukhumvit line) between Chit Lom and Nana; districts Pathum Wan/Watthana/Ratchathewi per app data. Wireless Road embassy belt runs south. Clipped by st.chit-lom (west) and st.nana (east); Benchasiri Park east belongs to st.phrom-phong.
entities.selection_rationale: Rank #6/133; rent 2 (near-most-expensive cohort) and nightlife 10 with only 33 mapped venues both need mechanism checks; coverage scan found thin dated independent coverage.

entities.scope_notes: MRT Sam Yan (Blue line) between Si Lom and Hua Lamphong stations; districts Pathum Wan/Bang Rak per app data. Chulalongkorn University and its campuses adjoin. Clipped by st.si-lom (north), st.hua-lamphong (south) and possibly st.lumphini (east).
entities.selection_rationale: Rank #7/133; vibe 10 / nightlife 10 with only 21 mapped nightlife venues — the largest nightlife-rating outlier yet; MRT-only rail access.

entities.scope_notes: MRT Sam Yot (Blue line) on Dinso Road, old town; districts Phra Nakhon/Pom Prap Sattru Phai/Samphanthawong (three khet) per app data. Rommaninat Park verified INSIDE this catchment by batch-2 research; Khlong Ong Ang promenade attributed here (batch-2). Clipped by st.sanam-chai (south) and st.wat-mangkon (southeast); eastern clip toward st.phetchaburi — verify.
entities.selection_rationale: Rank #8/133; old-town control pairing with the researched pom-prap/wat-mangkon; safety 5 to test; the green 9 rests on Rommaninat + Khlong Ong Ang per batch-2.

entities.scope_notes: BTS Sena Ruam (Sukhumvit line northern extension) at the Phahonyothin/Sena Ruam junction; district Phaya Thai per app data (verify — the area borders Chatuchak). Mid-ring residential grid; clipped by neighboring extension stations (south and north — verify keys).
entities.selection_rationale: Rank #9/133; the lowest-profile top-10 area — a coverage-reality check; nightlife 9 with 49 mapped venues is untested; rent is a Phaya Thai district blend.

entities.scope_notes: Airport Rail Link Ratchaprarop — ARL only, no BTS/MRT interchange; district Ratchathewi per app data. Pratunam market belt adjoins east. Clipped by st.phaya-thai (south), st.phetchaburi (southeast) and st.ratchathewi (southwest) — verify each.
entities.selection_rationale: Rank #12/133; the ARL-only control — what does transport 9 mean with no rail interchange?; safety 5 pattern to test (third entity at 5); Pratunam adjacency.
